name: kalro-farm
description: Kalro Farm Kenya - E-commerce platform for dairy goats, poultry and eggs

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
